name: lu.chathome/chathome
title: ChatHome — Luxembourg Real Estate
description: Home search in Luxembourg and its commuter belt, plus market data. Read-only, no account needed.

tools.name: search_vibe
tools.description: Natural-language ('vibe') property search: takes the user's request as prose and matches on lifestyle, mood, proximity, and soft preferences via embeddings + LLM reasoning. Strict matches have every required fact proven; close results name required facts that remain not confirmed and never present them as satisfied. Healthy runs return source-grounded match reasons and a 0-100 request-fit score (not a probability); degraded runs explicitly omit ranking claims. Every sourced result identifies and links the original agency listing and states its latest catalogue re-sighting time. The response's understanding block states what was understood; wishes in understanding.notChecked are not confirmed for any returned home. If the requested place cannot be resolved safely, it returns no listings plus a machine-readable unanswerable reason instead of substituting unrelated homes.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the user wants, in their own words — e.g. "quiet 2-bed near Kirchberg with a balcony under €2000" or "bright family house with a garden, short commute to Belval, energy class A". Lifestyle, vibe, proximity, and soft preferences all work here.

intent.description: Whether to search rentals or properties for sale (default: "rent")

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

limit.description: Number of results to return (max 50, default 20)

followUp.description: A change to the previous search or a question about its results, in the user’s own words — e.g. "cheaper", "like #2 but with a garden", "which one has parking?". Send it with the `brief` from the previous response (`session.brief`) and the same `query`. A question leaves the search unchanged and comes back as `followUp.reply`.

brief.description: The `session.brief` object from the previous search_vibe response, passed back unchanged to continue that search. Without `followUp` it replays the same search without re-reading the request.

shownListingIds.description: Ids of the listings you showed the user, in the order shown, so "#2" or "the second one" in `followUp` points at the right home.

includePhotos.description: Attach thumbnail photos of the top results as image content blocks (default: true). Set false for a lean text-only response.

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description: Search active Luxembourg rentals by location, rooms, area, property type, positive-evidence amenities, advertised base rent, or a separate strict confirmed monthly-obligation ceiling. The strict ceiling excludes listings when required recurring charges, fees, evidence, or source freshness are incomplete. Returned counts include explicit completeness metadata; every sourced result links the original agency listing and states its latest catalogue re-sighting time.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

commune.description: Supported municipality, city quarter or village name; use resolve_location if ambiguous

includeCrossBorder.description: Include homes in the cross-border commuter belt (FR, BE, DE); default false keeps Luxembourg only

maxTotalMonthly.description: Rental-only confirmed all-in monthly ceiling; missing cost evidence is excluded

shownListingIds.description: Already shown listing IDs, accumulated across pages. Excludes those IDs from this live result window; not a stable market snapshot.

tools.name: search_for_sale
tools.description: Search properties for sale in Luxembourg by default; includeCrossBorder opts into commuter-belt inventory by location, price, rooms, area, property type, and positive-evidence amenities, with explicit sort and completeness metadata. Every sourced result identifies and links the original agency listing and states its latest catalogue re-sighting time; thumbnails of the top results are attached as image content blocks.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

commune.description: Supported municipality, city quarter or village name; use resolve_location if ambiguous

includeCrossBorder.description: Include homes in the cross-border commuter belt (FR, BE, DE); default false keeps Luxembourg only

maxTotalMonthly.description: Rental-only confirmed all-in monthly ceiling; missing cost evidence is excluded

shownListingIds.description: Already shown listing IDs, accumulated across pages. Excludes those IDs from this live result window; not a stable market snapshot.

tools.name: render_listing_cards
tools.description: Renders one to eight results of a prior ChatHome property search as an interactive photo carousel. Takes the listing IDs, and any match scores and reasons, exactly as the search returned them, and re-reads the canonical public listing facts before display.

id.description: Exact listing ID copied from a prior search result

score.description: Exact match score returned by search_vibe

matchReasons.description: Exact match reasons returned by search_vibe

listings.description: One to eight exact listing IDs from search_vibe, search_rentals, or search_for_sale, in display order

heading.description: Short user-facing heading grounded in the search request

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Review a listing by ID or ChatHome URL without account linking. Returns the full fail-closed public listing page: price history, area trend, amenities, neighbourhood, passport, parcel dossier, costs, checks, transport, sources, unknowns, sourced page text, saved financial estimates with completeness flags, photos, section presence, the agency's contact (agencyContact) and original page for the user to reach it, and direct JSON/Markdown links. Sourced page text is the agency's own wording, returned as quoted data. Missing costs or imprecise coordinates never become confirmed totals or property-level checks.

id.description: Listing ID or a ChatHome listing URL; query strings and section links are accepted

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

includePhotos.description: Attach thumbnail photos of the listing as image content blocks (default: true). Set false for a lean text-only response.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Compare two to eight listing IDs or ChatHome URLs without account linking through normalized AgentListing v2 facts: known and estimated costs, availability, property, checks, station frequency, commute, value context, sources, freshness, duplicates and unknowns. Missing values never prove equality or become zero. Only active publicly eligible listings are returned.

ids.description: Two to eight listing IDs or ChatHome listing URLs

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_listing_truth
tools.description: Trust-layer view of the full fail-closed listing page, including its public record and page context, normalized costs, official checks, sources, freshness, explicit unknowns, and privacy-safe correction totals. No reporter identities are exposed.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_market_context
tools.description: Get bounded, source-backed property context for a commune, with source dates and unknown states. Link pageUrl when sharing the result.

commune.description: Luxembourg commune slug or name (e.g. 'luxembourg', 'esch-sur-alzette'). City quarters have a different scope and must not be treated as communes.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_town_agencies
tools.description: Get every estate agency with active listings in a supported Luxembourg town, including current buy/rent stock and asking-price ranges.

commune.description: One of the supported Luxembourg town names or slugs, e.g. 'Mersch' or 'esch-sur-alzette'

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_price_estimate
tools.description: AI-powered price estimate for a Luxembourg property. The chathome valuation model is trained and backtested on historical property listing asking prices, not deed-level sales. Returns an estimated price, confidence interval, comparable listing statistics and a link to the website estimator in toolUrl.

areaSqm.description: Living area for homes; plot area for land, in m². For land, an explicitly supplied landAreaSqm takes precedence.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_affordability
tools.description: Calculate Luxembourg mortgage affordability and state whether the property-price ceiling includes every acquisition cost or only currently known costs. Link toolUrl so the user can explore their assumptions.

maxDebtToIncomeRatio.description: Explicit housing-payment share of net income, e.g. 0.35

isFirstTimeBuyer.description: Deprecated optional compatibility signal; never proves Bëllegen entitlement

bellegenAktCreditAvailable.description: Aggregate unused Bëllegen Akt balance explicitly confirmed for the acquirers

residenceUse.description: Residence use; omitted or unknown preserves an unconfirmed Bëllegen position

isPersonalResidence.description: Deprecated residence-use compatibility flag; prefer residenceUse

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Calculate monthly loan payments, total interest and extra-payment scenarios using explicit principal, annualRatePct and years. A rate is a stated assumption, not a bank offer. Returns excluded costs; this is not an all-in housing budget. includeSchedule adds a detailed repayment table. Link toolUrl to let users explore the scenario. No account, profile write or loan application is needed.

principal.description: Loan principal in EUR, after the down payment; excludes acquisition costs unless explicitly financed

annualRatePct.description: Explicit annual interest-rate assumption in percent; do not invent a current bank quote

includeSchedule.description: Include the month-by-month schedule only when requested

tools.name: get_mortgage_rates
tools.description: Get dated Luxembourg bank housing-loan examples (each with its fixed period and loan term) and BCL/ECB signed-loan averages. A fixing period shorter than the loan term is never presented as a full-term rate. These are not personal bank offers. Link pageUrl to show these observations on ChatHome.

tools.name: calculate_buy_vs_rent
tools.description: Compare buying and renting the same Luxembourg home over time from an explicit price, comparable monthly rent and mortgage-rate assumption, with optional down payment, loan term, horizon and property tax. Uses the website simulator. winner stays null until every acquisition cost is confirmed or quoted; knownCostWinner is conditional on the costs known now. A scenario, not a verdict. Returns a link that opens the website tool prefilled.

monthlyRent.description: Monthly rent for a comparable home in EUR

mortgageRatePct.description: Explicit annual mortgage-rate assumption in percent

eligibleAcquirerCount.description: Buyers whose Bëllegen Akt eligibility is confirmed; omit when unknown

confirmedUnusedBellegenBalance.description: Confirmed unused Bëllegen Akt balance; omit when unknown

tools.name: calculate_acquisition_costs
tools.description: Luxembourg resale purchase costs from a price and main-home use: registration and transcription duties, the Bëllegen Akt credit only when eligibility and balance are confirmed, the Luxembourg City surcharge only when confirmed, notary tariff estimate or quoted amounts. Lists unknown components and policy sources; knownTotal excludes unknowns. New-build (VEFA) purchases are refused.

residenceUse.description: Whether the buyer will live in it as main home

eligibleAcquirerCount.description: Buyers whose Bëllegen Akt eligibility is confirmed; omit when unknown

confirmedUnusedBellegenBalance.description: Confirmed unused Bëllegen Akt balance; omit when unknown

quotes.description: Amounts from the user's own written quotes

tools.name: calculate_rent_subsidy
tools.description: Indicative Luxembourg rent subsidy (subvention de loyer) from household size, dependent children, previous-year monthly net income and rent, with dated official thresholds and step-by-step checkpoints. The Ministry decides; an eligible result is never an entitlement.

monthlyNetIncome.description: Household average monthly NET income for the previous calendar year

tools.name: calculate_rent_ceiling
tools.description: Luxembourg legal rent ceiling (5% of revalued invested capital). monthlyRent gives the capital a rent implies; price, purchaseYear and buildingYear (optional land price and works) give the owner's ceiling with its working and confidence. Only confidence 'verified' is the legal figure. Not legal advice.

monthlyRent.description: Rent to check: returns the invested capital it implies

price.description: Owner side: purchase price in EUR

landPrice.description: Land price when the deed separates it; omit otherwise

tools.name: check_plot
tools.description: Luxembourg plot check from an exact cadastral parcelRef or a precise lat/lng: PAG zoning, buildable envelope, existing buildings and planning, flood and heritage constraints, each with status, source and date. A coordinate returns location-scope context only; parcel identity and buildable figures need the cadastral reference. Information, not legal advice. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolves place names in Luxembourg and the neighbouring French, Belgian and German areas, translated aliases and official locality IDs. Country can narrow ambiguous names. Returns candidates instead of guessing. Quarter/village-to-parent widening and municipality-centre coordinates are explicit; no property-level precision is implied.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_quick_estimate
tools.description: Get a numeric Luxembourg property estimate without an account or AI-written report. Uses only the property facts supplied; omitted facts stay unknown. Returns ranges, coverage, assumptions, commune-average limitations and a link to the website estimator in toolUrl.

areaSqm.description: Living area for homes; plot area for land, in m². For land, an explicitly supplied landAreaSqm takes precedence.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

tools.name: get_commute_times
tools.description: Municipality-centre commute scenarios from supported LU/FR/BE/DE origins to six Luxembourg employment hubs across four modes. Country defaults to LU. Each result states its calculation date, scenario, fare and location scope; unavailable routes never become invented or nearby-town journeys. Link toolUrl to let users explore other journeys.
